mechanism: SQLAlchemy 1.4 rejects Placement online-data-migrations query construction that aliases a ScalarSelect as a FROM expression
repair_template: replace deprecated scalar-select alias construction with the compatible Query.subquery API

semantic_review.a1_failure: With only SQLAlchemy changed to 1.4.11, the pre-existing functional test reaches set_root_provider_ids and fails because sa.alias rejects the ScalarSelect produced by Query.as_scalar as a FROM expression; this normalized ArgumentError is exclusive to A1.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Fresh first-parent cutoff resolution, byte-exact opening and maintainer parent-to-head diffs, target patch application check, the existing tox.ini functional command, installed-version probes, all three arm logs, exclusive normalized failure signature, and no-test-deletion/no-skip inspection.
semantic_review.source_effect: The complete opening source diff changes only the global SQLAlchemy constraint from 1.3.23 to 1.4.11; installed-version probes confirm A0 consumed 1.3.23 and A1/A2 consumed 1.4.11.
semantic_review.target_repair: The complete maintainer parent-to-head diff changes only Placement's query construction from sa.alias(subq_1.as_scalar()) to subq_1.subquery(), providing a FROM-compatible subquery. The same existing functional test then passes in A2; no test was deleted, skipped, or weakened.
